# Repository source inclusion policy

This fork intentionally keeps media-source configuration separate from the public source code.

## Allowed in the public repository

- placeholder URLs such as `https://example.com/...`;
- upstream project links and documentation links;
- clearly identified infrastructure or metadata services whose purpose can be verified;
- source configuration schemas and examples that do not point to unknown media libraries.

## Not allowed in the public repository

- VOD / IPTV / TVBox / Apple CMS / M3U endpoints with unclear copyright or distribution authorization;
- private source lists supplied for personal testing;
- copied collections of third-party streaming endpoints;
- source URLs included merely because they are publicly reachable.

When authorization is uncertain, do not include the source URL in the repository.
